_comment: Seed fixture for the header-incident-summary-htmx widget-type bead.
Created for ka-0000005304 (Phase 4 free-htmx port — third port after
activity-log-htmx, MR !2334 / ka-0000004584 and related-tickets-htmx,
MR !2346 / ka-0000005540). Strategy A — port-then-soak: lives alongside
the Go-coded `header-incident-summary` slug rather than replacing it.
Authoring path:
kd create 'Free-htmx widget: header-incident-summary-htmx' \
--type=widget-type \
-F gardenio/controller/cmd/beads-viewer/fixtures/header-incident-summary-htmx.json
Pre-write hooks (kbeads/internal/server/widget_validation.go) parse
template_source under html/template and reject malformed inputs at
createBead/updateBead time, so a bad fixture surfaces immediately.
Schema validation runs against widget-instance writes per the same
pre-write hook; the schema below is the wire contract.
The wire contract mirrors the Go-coded `header-incident-summary`
renderer at widgets_phase4.go::renderHeaderIncidentSummary —
title/severity/status/started_at plus optional incident_id and
primary_action_url/primary_action_label for the action buttons.
The htmx template intentionally does NOT construct action buttons
(those need the Go-side OpenMRAction / AckIncidentAction helpers);
button rendering is a parity gap documented in the port doc and in
TestHeaderIncidentSummaryParity.

fields.template_source:
{{- $title := index .Payload "title" -}} {{- $severity := index .Payload "severity" -}} {{- $status := index .Payload "status" -}} {{- $startedAt := index .Payload "started_at" -}}
{{if $severity}}{{$severity}}{{end}} {{if $title}}

{{$title}}

{{end}} {{if $status}}{{$status}}{{end}}
{{if $startedAt}}

Started {{$startedAt}}

{{end}}
